title: Biocentric/gutportrait pipeline - params.input schema
description: One row per sample in the ampliseq run: the personal samples and every reference-panel sample. Counts come from the ampliseq results directory; everything else comes from this sheet.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers and underscores (ampliseq's rule). It must match a column of dada2/ASV_table.tsv.

role.errorMessage: role must be 'personal' (the samples being positioned) or 'panel' (the reference they are positioned against)

study.errorMessage: study must be given and contain no spaces. It is the batch term used for between-study spread and batch correction.

run.errorMessage: run must be given and contain no spaces. Use the sequencing flowcell from the read headers, not the ENA run accession.

age_cat.errorMessage: age_cat must be one of 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s, 70+ (American Gut's adult bands), or left empty

sex.errorMessage: sex must be male, female or other, or left empty

bmi_cat.errorMessage: bmi_cat must be Underweight, Normal, Overweight or Obese (American Gut's bands), or left empty

country.errorMessage: country is free text and may be left empty

context.description: Optional free-text sampling context for personal samples, e.g. "baseline" or "after a diet change". Carried into the percentile, alpha and flag tables.
context.errorMessage: context is free text and may be left empty
